method: OpenAI image generation; one new wordless illustration per approved story
style: Create one original editorial illustration for the Swiss Folklore reading website in the Märchen Engine v2 Romantic-naturalist field-guide style. Landscape 3:2, 1536 by 1024. A delicately hand-tinted nineteenth-century copperplate engraving: exceptionally fine bistre linework and crosshatching, warm pale cream paper, restrained herbarium sage, tarnished brass and a trace of oxblood. Muted, airy, tactile printed art, coherent natural depth, patient uncanny atmosphere. Full scene to the edges, no drawn border or frame. Absolutely no lettering, words, numbers, captions, signatures, watermarks or logos. No photography, glossy digital rendering, cartoon outlines, modern objects, game mechanics or RPG symbols. Keep the complete main subjects in the central 85 percent. Read the approved folktale below, then depict ONE concrete, visually memorable scene from it, faithfully preserving the actual characters, objects and setting. Use restrained preindustrial Swiss clothing and Alpine architecture where applicable. Imply the supernatural through atmosphere and posture; no graphic violence or gore. Avoid a collage or a collection of unrelated icons. The title is for context only: do not put it or any text in the illustration.
